summary: Himax Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing its first quarter 2026 financial results and second quarter 2026 guidance. The release reports Q1 2026 revenue of $199.0 million, gross margin of 30.4%, and after-tax profit of $8.0 million (4.6 cents per diluted ADS), exceeding guidance. Q2 guidance projects 10-13% sequential revenue growth and gross margin around 32%. Management discusses positive outlook from automotive and non-driver IC businesses. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation.
